summary: Register MutationObserver options with DOM validation and subtree/transient-observer semantics.

target.notes: Normalize options defaults, validate contradictory/empty configurations, update an existing registration for the same observer/target, and support subtree mutation semantics.

caveats: attributeOldValue with attributes:false and characterDataOldValue with characterData:false are errors.

tests.name: childList observation works
tests.input: const n=document.createElement('div'); const m=new MutationObserver(()=>{}); m.observe(n,{childList:true}); n.append(document.createElement('i')); console.log(m.takeRecords().length);
